products.name: Sysracks 22U 39 in Deep IT & Telecom Cabinet (SRF 22.6.10)
products.summary: 22U, 39-inch-deep enclosed floor cabinet with glass door, thermostat-controlled fans and brush inlets.
products.description: The Sysracks SRF 22.6.10 is a 22U floor-standing IT cabinet, 24 in wide and 39 in deep with a glass front door and detachable side panels. Welded frames are rated to 1,600 lb, brush cable inlets sit top and bottom, four rails adjust up to 34 in apart, and a thermostat switches the fan panel on as temperatures rise.
